_doc: Act-0 onboarding chain. A linear sequence of pipeline quests; the loader links each step to unlock the next (chain_unlocks). Each step teaches ONE mechanic; completion is a SOFT predicate (unified vocabulary) the player watches fill — the progress bar is the teacher. Authored body/hint are preserved by the pipeline (voice never clobbers them). Every hint LEADS WITH THE WHAT (first sentence = the ask, ≤70 chars, stands alone — the banner clips to it) and follows with the HOW; every gate fires on the mechanic its step teaches. Act 0 teaches only the farm verbs — instant, legible, no waits: loop, contracts, travel, superposition, entanglement, and then the capstone: reap. Reap comes LAST on purpose — it is once-affordable early (Fibonacci 🍼 costs) and reaps every biome at once, so it lands after the player has built a field worth reaping; the entanglement step's claim pays its cost. Vocabulary (berry tracking + incorporation) is deliberately ABSENT here: it is mid-game content, taught by the act-3 chapter; early words come from faction teachings on the road (story_flags.json).

steps.body: The Demos sleeps — wheat and people, waiting. Explore a plot, strike its qubit to collapse it, then gather what the collapse leaves behind.
steps.tutorial_hint: Strike a plot (R), then gather the yield (Q). Pick plots with G H J K L ; — or just tap one. F explores new ground (an expedition costs 🍞), R strikes (a social encounter costs 👥), Q gathers the yield (costs 🧺). Ace is your starting hat (8); the number row 4-0 swaps hats for new Q/E/R/F verbs. E pauses to look; F plays on.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant the gate ledger records 1 measure gate (a single R-strike) — a structural count, not a soft gate.

steps.body: The Millwright's Union is buying. Accept their contract and deliver 2× 🌾 from your stores. Kept contracts are how a small country eats — and how factions come to know your name.
steps.tutorial_hint: Gather 2× 🌾: strike [R], gather [Q] — or just tap the bubbles. The granary you already hold counts too. Then deliver: tap 📋 [C], Commitments [U], this contract's row — tap it twice (Deliver [R]). (To accept it in the first place: tap the gold banner [X→I], its row, then Accept [R] — every quest ahead works the same way.)
steps.math_note: A DELIVERY quest, not a soft gate — fires the instant your 🌾 stores hold quantity ≥ 2 and you complete the contract. This step alone is NOT auto-accepted/claimed: you learn the real accept→do→claim ceremony every market contract uses.

steps.body: The Demos is one country on a wider island. Past the hedge the forest keeps older words. Go and stand under its canopy.
steps.tutorial_hint: Go to StarterForest — stand under its canopy. Tap its orb on the left rail (or press its key, T Y U row) to cross; this step completes on arrival.
steps.math_note: Structural predicate (active_biome_is): scores 1.0 the instant StarterForest is the biome under your feet, 0.0 otherwise — arrival is the whole ask, no soft gate. The objective banner's travel line names the orb and its key while you are elsewhere and drops the moment you arrive.

steps.body: A qubit need not pick a side. Superpose it — spread it across both poles — and the forest shimmers between states.
steps.tutorial_hint: Superpose the forest — raise coherence past 0.3. Druid hat (0): E lays a Hadamard on the selected plot; watch the bar fill as the shimmer spreads.
steps.math_note: Soft gate on StarterForest coherence, center 0.3, width 0.05 (default) — the bar crosses fire-ready (score ≥ 0.85) at coherence ≈ 0.34, a hair past the stated 0.3.
steps._unlock_note: Completing this step fires the loom_opens spine flag, which unlocks the Operator hat (UIProgression.HAT_UNLOCK_FLAGS) the NEXT step (entanglement) needs — the tutorial hands the spine forward instead of racing it (Break #2). The forest_listener handoff this replaced now lives in the act-3 berry chapter, where that flag's own predicates fire it naturally.

steps.body: A qubit alone is a wheel. Two qubits woven together are a loom — touch one and the other answers, however far apart they drift.
steps.tutorial_hint: Weave two plots into one Bell pair. Operator hat: tap its chip (or 9). Shift+click two plots (or Shift + their keys) picks the pair, R opens the gate picker — then Q weaves the Bell. Watch the gold thread between their bubbles — each weave pulls them closer, and the bar fills as you weave.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant the gate ledger records 1 bell gate (a single Bell weave) — a structural count, not a soft gate. Completing this weave hands you 1 🍼 — the reap capstone's cost, paid forward.

steps.body: Explore, strike, gather — you have the beats. Now turn time itself: reap the season, and every plot the country holds settles and pays at once. Every country ahead runs on these same four verbs.
steps.tutorial_hint: Reap the season — the whole country pays at once. Come home to TheDemos and put the field in play: tap unexplored plots (or F — each costs 🍞). Then Ace hat (8): Shift+click the F chip — its ⇧ line names Reap Season — or hold Shift and press F. Time runs forward, every explored plot settles, and the harvest lands together. Costs 1 🍼 — the bottle you carry is for exactly this.
steps.math_note: Fires on 1 recorded reap gate — a structural count over the durable gate ledger (survives save/load; a refused reap does not count). Reap only has material when explored plots are still in play (a gathered plot left the season). Reap costs follow the sequence 1,1,2,3,5,8,…🍼; the entanglement step's claim paid your first.
